parameters.query:
WITH dados AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb)
    AS x(id_login int, id_contrato int, id_onu int, id_transmissor int, ponid text,
         id_caixa_ftth int, porta_ftth int, status_internet text, sinal_rx numeric, data_sinal timestamp)
), up AS (
  INSERT INTO clientes_cto (id_login, id_contrato, id_onu, id_transmissor, ponid, id_caixa_ftth,
                            porta_ftth, status_internet, sinal_rx, data_sinal, atualizado_em)
  SELECT id_login, id_contrato, id_onu, id_transmissor, ponid, id_caixa_ftth,
         porta_ftth, status_internet, sinal_rx, data_sinal, now() FROM dados
  ON CONFLICT (id_login) DO UPDATE SET
    id_contrato = EXCLUDED.id_contrato, id_onu = EXCLUDED.id_onu, id_transmissor = EXCLUDED.id_transmissor,
    ponid = EXCLUDED.ponid, id_caixa_ftth = EXCLUDED.id_caixa_ftth, porta_ftth = EXCLUDED.porta_ftth,
    status_internet = EXCLUDED.status_internet, sinal_rx = EXCLUDED.sinal_rx,
    data_sinal = EXCLUDED.data_sinal, atualizado_em = now()
  RETURNING id_login
), del AS (
  DELETE FROM clientes_cto WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM dados) > 0
    AND id_login NOT IN (SELECT id_login FROM dados) RETURNING id_login
)
, pdados AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb) AS p(id_login int, id_contrato int, motivo text)
), pend AS (
  INSERT INTO cadastro_pendente (id_login, id_contrato, motivo, atualizado_em)
  SELECT id_login, id_contrato, motivo, now() FROM pdados
  ON CONFLICT (id_login) DO UPDATE SET id_contrato = EXCLUDED.id_contrato, motivo = EXCLUDED.motivo, atualizado_em = now()
  RETURNING 1
), pend_del AS (
  DELETE FROM cadastro_pendente WHERE id_login NOT IN (SELECT id_login FROM pdados) RETURNING 1
)
INSERT INTO sync_log (fluxo, inicio, fim, registros, status, obs)
VALUES ('clientes_cto', $3::timestamptz, now(), (SELECT count(*) FROM up), 'ok',
        'removidos: ' || (SELECT count(*) FROM del) || ' | pendentes: ' || (SELECT count(*) FROM pend) || ' | ' || $4)
RETURNING fluxo, registros, obs;
